title: Orbit reservations — EU availability zones & new instance tiers GTM coordination
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Coordinate cross-functional GTM for launching Dedicated capacity in two new EU availability zones with three new instance tiers and a revised reservation product. Objectives: ensure coherent release notes, billing/reservations SKUs, console UI updates, marketing materials, partner marketplace listings, and Sales enablement. Drive end-to-end checklist from internal signoffs to public launch and cadence for post-launch pricing telemetry and early-customer migration support.
checklist: Finalize technical gating: infra signoff (ENG-16320) for AZ failover and capacity tests
Confirm instance tier naming and SKU IDs with billing -> update pricing sheet
Draft release notes and changelog entry for public API and Console features
Ship Console copy/UX changes for reservation purchase flow (DES-224 review)
Run end-to-end e2e tests for reservation lifecycle (purchase -> renew -> cancel)
Prepare Marketing announcement and one-pager for Solutions/SDR teams
Create Sales playbook + objection handling for EU price/commitment model
Coordinate marketplace listing artifacts and compliance checklist
Set up telemetry dashboards and SLO guardrails for first 30 days
Schedule canary rollout (10% of traffic) and fallback procedure
notes: 2026-03-05 — Kickoff: scoped launch to eu-west-3 + eu-central-2 AZs; initial SKU draft uses tier names S1,S2,S3 but design prefers 'burst' nomenclature — decision: keep numeric tiers for clarity in billing, surface friendly names in UI
2026-03-07 — Billing asks to reserve SKU namespace 'dedicated.europe.v2' to avoid conflicts with older reservations; Action: PM to request finance approval for SKU reservation
2026-03-09 — Trade-off: delaying Console UX polish by 3 days reduces launch risk for backend but increases support load — accepted with mitigations (enhanced docs & support playbook)
2026-03-11 — Release notes owner assigned to Omar; format will include customer-facing summary, migration steps, API compatibility notes, and known limitations (KV-cache warmup behavior in new AZs)
2026-03-12 — Security review not required for SKU/API changes but Legal needs templated terms for reservation commitments > 12 months
2026-03-13 — Canary plan validated with SRE: 72-hour canary window, automated rollback on 5% error spike or token-creation latency > 75th percentile threshold
2026-03-14 — Marketing draft ready for internal review; ask: final pricing table and promo credits to include in announcement
followups: By 2026-03-16: Confirm finalized pricing SKUs and send to Finance for approval
By 2026-03-18: Complete Console copy updates and run accessibility audit
By 2026-03-20: Publish internal release notes and distribute Sales playbook
Launch window: 2026-03-25 to 2026-03-28 (canary then full rollout pending canary results)
Post-launch (day 7 & day 30): Review telemetry for cost per-token and reservation utilization; iterate pricing/offer if utilization < 20%
